'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Roya girl who can be found quizzing to two Students from the Department of Voidmatters at the front of Startorch Academy entrance, to find her brother who is attending.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==

==Dialogue==
:'''Merill:''' The square root of this is... and when I square that, I get... Oh!  19!
:'''Struss:''' From a bird's-eye view of the Academy, the Reactor's light... is angled directly at the Energy Sciences!
:'''Struss:''' If I put that all together… Your older brother is 19 years old and an Energy Sciences student!
:'''Tuppence:''' That's correct! Hmm, what should I ask next...?
:'''Merill:''' Hold on. You're making us solve your questions to get info about your brother?
:'''Merill:''' If you want to find him, wouldn't it be easier to just tell us what he looks like?
:'''Tuppence:''' Hehe, but this is a game my brother and I play. I have to find him using questions!
:'''Tuppence:''' When I do, he promised me a huge feast at the Startorch Academy cafeteria! I've never eaten there before, I can't wait!
:'''Struss:''' Y-you can't... wait?
:'''Merill:''' Oh, sweetie. You're a bright kid and we want to help, but… the cafeteria food is, uh…
:'''Tuppence:''' Next question coming up! Listen carefully, everyone!
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}} 
:'''Struss:''' Differentiate Helios's refractive index... the answer is 4...
:'''Merill:''' Zip Zap's post-Void Storm stroboscopic band... The encoded translation of the word is energy gel?
:'''Tuppence:''' Hehe, right again.
:'''Struss:''' So after you found your brother, he treated you to four different flavors of energy gels?
:'''Tuppence:''' Yup! And is this really what you eat every day? That's rough.
:'''Merill:''' The texture is pretty weird. But hey, we eat other things, too...
:'''Tuppence:''' But my brother said this is the Academy's specialty, recommended by Professor Mornye, the amazing woman who launched Helios. He packed a ton for me to take back.
:'''Tuppence:''' He also said that if I solve these problems, I'll figure out how to make energy gel taste better!
:'''Struss:''' R-Really? I've never heard that before...
:'''Merill:''' We'd like to figure that out too. Can we work on it with you?
:'''Tuppence:''' Of course. Listen closely. My brother's problem goes like this...
{{Dialogue End}}
